newsitem.title: USA: Checkpoint says Q3 eps hurt by hurricane.
newsitem.headline: Checkpoint says Q3 eps hurt by hurricane.

text.p: Checkpoint Systems Inc said on Tuesday that its third quarter revenues and earnings would not meet analyst estimates because of the impact of Hurricane Hortense and delayed product rollout in supermarket chains.
Checkpoint said in a statement third quarter revenues would be about $5 million below estimates and earnings per share would be about $0.05 to $0.06 below estimates because of these two factors.
The First Call mean estimate for the third quarter was $0.20 per share against $0.16 per share in the same period last year.

"Although our manufacturing and distribution facility in Puerto Rico is now running at full production, we estimate that eight days of production were lost from a combination of electrical and water outages," President and Chief Executive Officer Kevin Dowd said in a statement.
"In addition, transportation issues made it difficult for employees to get to the plant and interrupted deliveries of materials and electronic parts," he said.
Dowd also said orders from supermarkets were behind plan in the United States.
"However, contingent upon the completion of contracts for two major U.S. supermarket chains, we believe our momentum in the United States will accelerate," he said.
Checkpoint provides integrated security solutions for the protection of assets in retail, industrial and institutional applications.
